formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: For topical ophthalmic and dermal use only. Transient blurred vision occurs upon ocular instillation (avoid operating machinery); incompatible with oxidizers and alkaline solutions.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Capsules / Tablets (100 mg Doxycycline Hyclate / Monohydrate) & Lyophilized IV Infusion Powder (100 mg Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Oral: Swallow whole with 250 mL water. IV: Reconstitute 100 mg vial with 10 mL Sterile Water for Injection (SWFI) or 0.9% NS (10 mg/mL), then further dilute in 100–1000 mL 0.9% NS or D5W (target 0.1–1.0 mg/mL).
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Take with food or light snack to reduce nausea; remain standing/upright for ≥30 minutes. IV Infusion: Infuse diluted 100 mg solution over 1 to 4 hours (minimum 60 minutes; never bolus).
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store dry powder and oral forms at 20–25°C protected from light. IV solution stable for 12 hours at room temperature in D5W/NS or 48 hours refrigerated (2–8°C) if protected from light.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Oral chelation with calcium, antacids, bismuth subsalicylate, and iron salts (separate by ≥2h). IV infusion causes phlebitis if infused rapidly or at >1 mg/mL. Incompatible with riboflavin and amphotericin B.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Capsules / Extended-Release Tablets (50 mg & 100 mg Minocycline HCl) & Lyophilized Powder for IV Injection (100 mg Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Oral: Swallow whole with full glass of fluid. IV: Reconstitute 100 mg vial with 5–10 mL Sterile Water for Injection, then further dilute immediately in 500–1000 mL 0.9% NS, D5W, or Ringer's Injection.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Ingest with water, may be taken with food/milk without significantly reduced absorption (unlike older tetracyclines). IV Infusion: Infuse slowly over 60 minutes every 12 hours.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store oral capsules and intact vials at 20–25°C protected from moisture and heat. Reconstituted IV solution must be further diluted immediately; diluted solution stable for 24 hours at room temperature.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Chelates with multivalent cations (Al, Mg, Fe antacids). Incompatible with solutions containing calcium if pH becomes alkaline. High lipid solubility increases vestibular penetration (vertigo warning).

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Lyophilized Powder for IV Infusion (50 mg Single-Dose Glass Vial as Orange Cake/Powder)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute each 50 mg vial with 5.3 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose Injection to achieve 10 mg/mL. Swirl gently until dissolved. Immediately dilute into 100 mL IV bag of 0.9% NS or D5W (concentration ≤1 mg/mL).
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Intravenous Infusion only: Administer 100 mg loading dose over 30 to 60 minutes, followed by 50 mg over 30 to 60 minutes every 12 hours via dedicated IV line or flushed lumen.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store intact vials below 25°C. Following reconstitution and dilution in IV bag, stable for up to 24 hours at room temperature (≤25°C) or up to 48 hours refrigerated at 2–8°C.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Co-infusion incompatibilities: Y-site incompatible with amphotericin B, diazepam, lansoprazole, pantoprazole, and omeprazole. Inactive against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Proteus spp.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Hard Gelatin Capsules / Blister Strips (Doxycycline Hyclate 100 mg + Lactic Acid Bacillus 5 Billion Spores / 60 Million Spores)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Solid oral fixed-dose unit dosage form. Swallow whole with an abundant volume of potable water (≥200 mL). Do not open, chew, or crush capsule.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral Administration: Ingest after a light meal to prevent nausea while preserving probiotic viability; maintain strict upright posture for at least 30 minutes post-dose to prevent esophageal ulceration.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store below 25°C in a dry environment protected from light and moisture. Alu-Alu blister packaging preserves probiotic spore viability and protects hygroscopic doxycycline salt from ambient humidity.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Polyvalent metal cation binding: Space at least 2 hours apart from aluminum/magnesium antacids, iron supplements, and sucralfate. Probiotic spore viability is resilient to gastric acid.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Aqueous Solution for Injection / Infusion (100 mg/2 mL, 250 mg/2 mL, 500 mg/2 mL Vials)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use liquid solution. For IV infusion, dilute 500 mg dose in 100–200 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose Injection (concentration 2.5–5 mg/mL).
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion / Deep IM: Administer IV infusion over 30 to 60 minutes in adults (1 to 2 hours in infants); never administer as rapid IV bolus. Deep IM into large muscle mass.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store intact vials at 20–25°C; solution may darken slightly to pale yellow without loss of potency. Diluted IV solutions stable for 24 hours at room temperature (≤25°C) and 48 hours at 2–8°C.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Physically and chemically incompatible with beta-lactams (penicillins and cephalosporins) due to mutual aminolysis inactivation; do not mix in same IV bag or Y-site. Potentiates neuromuscular blocking agents.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Aqueous Solution for Injection (80 mg/2 mL, 20 mg/2 mL Vials / Ampoules)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use liquid solution. For IV infusion, dilute dose in 50–200 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose Injection (concentration ≤1 mg/mL).
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion / IM: Infuse IV over 30 to 60 minutes (minimum 30 min; do not give IV push); deep IM into gluteus maximus or anterolateral thigh.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store ampoules/vials at 20–25°C. Diluted infusion solutions in NS or D5W remain stable for 24 hours at room temperature. Do not freeze.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Chemical inactivation occurs when mixed with penicillins (e.g., ampicillin, piperacillin); administer via separate IV lines or flush thoroughly between infusions. Synergistic toxicity with furosemide, vancomycin, and amphotericin B.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Solution for Injection (80 mg/2 mL Vial) & Inhalation Solution (300 mg/5 mL Single-Dose Ampoule for Nebulization)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Injection: Dilute dose in 50–100 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose. Inhalation: Pre-mixed sterile aqueous solution; do not dilute or mix with other drugs in the nebulizer cup.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion / Inhalation: Infuse IV over 20 to 60 minutes. Inhalation: Administer 300 mg via PARI LC PLUS reusable nebulizer with DeVilbiss Pulmo-Aide compressor over ~15 minutes.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Intact injection vials store at 20–25°C. Inhalation ampoules store refrigerated at 2–8°C in foil pouches; stable at room temperature (≤25°C) for up to 28 days. Protect from intense light.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with heparin, cefepime, and penicillins in IV solution. Inhalation solution should not be mixed with dornase alfa or bronchodilators in the same nebulizer chamber.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Aqueous Solution for Injection (50 mg/mL, 100 mg/mL, 200 mg/2 mL, 300 mg/1.5 mL Ampoules/Vials)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use solution. For IV infusion, dilute the required dose in 50 to 200 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose Injection.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion / Deep IM: Administer IV infusion slowly over 30 to 60 minutes. Deep IM injection into the upper outer quadrant of the buttock.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store at 15–30°C. Protect from light and freezing. Reconstituted/diluted IV admixtures are physically and chemically stable for 24 hours at controlled room temperature.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Y-site and admixture incompatible with beta-lactam antibiotics. Enhanced neuromuscular blockade when combined with succinylcholine, vecuronium, or pancuronium. Avoid co-administration with ethacrynic acid.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for Deep IM Injection (0.75 g & 1.0 g Glass Vials)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute 1.0 g vial with 3.0 to 3.5 mL of Sterile Water for Injection (SWFI) or 0.9% Sodium Chloride to yield approximately 250 mg/mL or 200 mg/mL solution.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Deep Intramuscular Injection only: Administer deep into upper outer quadrant of gluteal muscle. Avoid intravascular injection; rotate injection sites. (IV administration strictly contraindicated unless specialized protocol).
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store dry powder at 20–25°C protected from light. Reconstituted aqueous solution retains potency for 24 hours at room temperature (≤25°C) and up to 14 days when refrigerated at 2–8°C.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with calcium gluconate, sodium bicarbonate, and sulfadiazine. Severe risk of enhanced ototoxicity with co-administered loop diuretics (furosemide, bumetanide). Extreme neuromuscular blockage warning.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Lyophilized Powder / Aqueous Solution for Injection (500 mg & 1000 mg Vials)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Lyophilized powder: Dissolve 1000 mg in 3 mL SWFI. For IV infusion, dilute 1000 mg in 200–400 mL 0.9% NS or 5% Dextrose Injection.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Deep IM / IV Infusion: Administer deep IM into large muscle. For IV infusion, infuse steadily over 30 to 60 minutes; never administer as rapid IV bolus.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store intact vials below 25°C protected from light. Reconstituted solution is stable for 24 hours at room temperature and 7 days at 2–8°C. Darkening does not affect activity.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Physical incompatibility with methicillin, ampicillin, and cephalothin. Concomitant use with polymyxins, colistin, or platinum compounds precipitates irreversible acute tubular necrosis and eighth nerve toxicity.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Aqueous Solution for IV Infusion (500 mg/10 mL Single-Dose Clear Glass Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Dilute calculated dose (based on actual/adjusted body weight) from 500 mg/10 mL vial into 100 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose Injection bag.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Intravenous Infusion only: Administer over 30 minutes using a dedicated IV line or flush line with 0.9% NS prior to and immediately following infusion.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store intact vials refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C. Diluted IV infusion solution in NS or D5W is stable for 24 hours at room temperature (20–25°C) or up to 7 days refrigerated at 2–8°C.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Do not infuse simultaneously through the same IV line with other intravenous drugs or beta-lactams. Potentiates respiratory depression from non-depolarizing neuromuscular blocking agents.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Hard Gelatin Capsules (250 mg) & Parenteral Solution for Deep IM Injection (750 mg/2 mL Ampoule)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Oral: Ingest whole with water. IM: Ready-to-use sterile aqueous solution (750 mg/2 mL, equivalent to 375 mg/mL paromomycin base). No dilution required for IM.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral / Deep IM: Oral capsules taken with meals to minimize gastrointestinal upset. IM injection administered deep into gluteal musculature once daily for Kala-azar.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store capsules and parenteral ampoules below 25°C protected from light, freezing, and moisture. Discard opened single-use ampoules immediately.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: IM injection incompatible with intravenous mixing or alkaline solutions. Oral absorption increases markedly in mucosal ulcerations, increasing systemic ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity risk.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Film-Coated Tablets (500 mg Neomycin Sulfate, equivalent to 350 mg base) & Oral Solution
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Solid oral dosage form. Ingest with a full glass of potable water (200–250 mL). Oral solution may be diluted in juice if palatability is an issue.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral administration: Take on an empty stomach or with light meals according to bowel preparation schedule or hepatic encephalopathy interval (every 6 hours).
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store tablets at 20–25°C in tightly closed, moisture-resistant containers protected from excessive humidity and light.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Binds and impairs absorption of oral digoxin, penicillin V, vitamin K, and oral anticoagulants (monitor INR closely). Severe toxicity if administered parenterally (strictly contraindicated by IV/IM).

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Topical Dermatological Ointment / Cream (0.5% w/w Neomycin Sulfate, often combined with Polymyxin B 5,000 U/g + Bacitracin 400 U/g)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Semi-solid topical preparation. Ready to use. No reconstitution or dilution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Topical Dermal Application: Cleanse affected cutaneous area; apply thin layer of ointment 1 to 3 times daily; may cover with sterile porous gauze dressing.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store at 15–30°C in original collapsible aluminum or laminated tube. Do not freeze. Keep tube cap tightly sealed after each use.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: For external dermatological use only; avoid contact with conjunctiva or mucous membranes. Incompatible with heavy metal salts and anionic surfactants. High contact allergy sensitization rate.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Ophthalmic Solution (0.3% w/v Eye Drops in 5 mL Dropper Bottle) & Sterile Eye Ointment (0.3% w/w in 3.5 g Tube)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Pre-formulated sterile ophthalmic solution/ointment. Ready to use. Do not dilute.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Ophthalmic Instillation: Drops: Instill 1–2 drops into conjunctival sac of affected eye(s) q4h (q1–2h in acute phase). Ointment: Apply 1 cm ribbon into conjunctival fornix TID or at bedtime.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store at 2°C to 25°C. Protect from excessive heat and direct sunlight. Discard remaining contents 28 to 30 days after opening dropper bottle to prevent contamination.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Do not touch dropper tip to eyelashes, eyelids, or fingers. Remove soft contact lenses before instillation (preservative benzalkonium chloride absorbs into contact lenses). Separate from other eye drops by ≥5 min.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Ophthalmic Solution / Ointment (0.3% w/v in 5 mL / 10 mL Vial) & Topical Cream / Ointment (0.1% w/w in 15 g Tube)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use sterile preparations. No diluent or reconstitution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Ophthalmic / Topical: Drops: 1–2 drops into conjunctival sac every 4 to 8 hours. Dermal: Apply thin layer to cleansed affected wound 3–4 times daily.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store between 15°C and 25°C. Protect from light and freezing. Discard ophthalmic dropper container 30 days after first breaking tamper-evident seal.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Ophthalmic solution incompatible with sulfacetamide sodium (precipitate forms). Inactive in presence of purulent exudate or heavy debris; cleanse wound prior to application.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Topical Skin Cream / Ointment (1% w/w Framycetin Sulfate in 30 g / 100 g Tubes) & Sterile Impregnated Gauze Dressing (Sofra-Tulle 10 cm x 10 cm)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use semi-solid cream or sterile paraffin-impregnated tulle unit gauze. No dilution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Topical Cutaneous Application: Apply thin layer of 1% cream directly over lesion 1–3 times daily; or apply single layer of impregnated tulle gauze over cleaned wound and secure with dressing.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store below 25°C in cool, dry conditions. Do not freeze. Sterile gauze pouches must remain sealed until application; discard opened unused dressings.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: External use only; strictly avoid application into middle ear if tympanic membrane is perforated (causes permanent sensorineural deafness). Incompatible with oxidizing agents and tannic acid.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Topical Dermatological Cream / Ointment (0.1% w/w Sisomicin Sulfate in 10 g / 15 g Collapsible Tubes)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use semi-solid topical vehicle. No reconstitution or dilution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Topical Dermal Application: Gently massage a thin layer into affected skin area 2 to 3 times daily; may apply protective sterile bandage.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store below 25°C protected from light, moisture, and excessive heat. Keep tube capped tightly.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: For external dermatological use only. Avoid application to large raw denuded body surfaces or eyes. Incompatible with strong alkaline solutions and silver salts.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Tablets (Single Strength 400/80 mg, Double Strength 800/160 mg), Pediatric Suspension (200/40 mg per 5 mL) & IV Infusion Concentrate (400/80 mg per 5 mL Ampoule)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: IV: Dilute each 5 mL ampoule into 125 mL D5W (or 75 mL in fluid-restricted patients). Must NOT be injected undiluted.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Administer with meals and a full glass of water. IV Infusion: Infuse over 60 to 90 minutes. Never give as rapid push or bolus.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store below 25°C protected from light. IV admixture in D5W is stable for 6 hours (1:25 dilution) or 2 hours (1:15 dilution). Inspect visually for crystallization.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Do NOT mix or infuse with other medications or standard saline. Incompatible with normal saline (crystallization risk). Precipitates if refrigerated.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Tablets (Fixed-Dose Combination: Sulfadoxine 500 mg + Pyrimethamine 25 mg)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-administer solid oral tablet formulation. No reconstitution or dilution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Administer required number of tablets at once with plenty of drinking water after a meal. Tablets may be crushed for pediatric administration.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store below 30°C in airtight containers protected from direct sunlight and humidity.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with concurrent antifolate therapy (methotrexate, trimethoprim) due to additive marrow toxicity. Take with food to minimize gastric irritation.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Enteric-Coated (EN-tabs) & Immediate-Release Oral Tablets (500 mg)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Solid oral dosage form. No reconstitution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Ingest whole with a full glass of water after meals; do not break, chew, or crush enteric-coated tablets. Distribute doses evenly throughout the day.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store at controlled room temperature (20°C to 25°C). Keep in tightly sealed containers away from excessive moisture.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Reduces absorption of digoxin and folic acid. Colestipol and cholestyramine bind sulfasalazine in the gastrointestinal tract, decreasing bioavailability.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Topical Micronized Cream 1% w/w (in 20 g, 50 g, 100 g, 250 g and 500 g Jars/Tubes)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use sterile topical hydrophilic cream vehicle. No reconstitution or mixing required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Topical Cutaneous: Cleanse and debride burn wound, then apply 1–2 mm thick layer with sterile gloved hands 1–2 times daily, with or without dressing.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store between 15°C and 30°C. Do not freeze. Discard if color turns dark pink or brownish due to silver oxidation upon exposure to light.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with proteolytic enzymatic debriding agents (collagenase, papain) as heavy metals (silver) inactivate proteolytic enzymes. Inactivated by purulent exudate.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Ophthalmic Solution 10% & 20% w/v (in 5 mL / 10 mL Dropper Bottles) and Ophthalmic Ointment 10% w/w (in 3.5 g / 5 g Tubes)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Ready-to-use sterile ophthalmic liquid/ointment. No dilution required.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Ophthalmic: Instill 1–2 drops into conjunctival sac of affected eye(s) every 2–3 hours; apply thin ribbon of ointment along lower lid margin at bedtime.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store between 8°C and 25°C. Protect from light and excessive heat. Do not use if solution is dark brown or contains particulate precipitate.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with silver preparations (silver nitrate, mild silver protein), mercurial solutions, and zinc sulfate. Antagonized by PABA-containing anesthetics (procaine, tetracaine).

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Topical Cream 8.5% (as acetate, 85 mg/g in 56.7 g / 411 g Jars) & Powder for Topical Solution (5% topical packet)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Cream is ready to apply; packet powder is reconstituted with 1000 mL sterile water for irrigation to prepare 5% aqueous topical solution.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Topical Cutaneous: Apply cream 1/16th inch (1–2 mm) thick to burned areas twice daily with sterile gloved hand. Maintain continuously moist with gauze for 5% solution.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store cream at 20°C to 25°C. Protect from freezing and excessive heat. Reconstituted 5% solution is stable for 28 days at room temperature.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Do not mix with other topical agents or silver sulfadiazine. Rapid systemic absorption causes carbonic anhydrase inhibition; monitor ABGs closely.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for Injection / Infusion (500 mg & 1 g Vials)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute 500 mg with 10 mL and 1 g with 20 mL Sterile Water for Injection (SWFI). Further dilute in 50–100 mL Normal Saline (0.9% NaCl) or D5W.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion: Infuse over 15 to 30 minutes; for critical care MDR infections/sepsis, administer as an extended infusion over 3 hours. IV Bolus: 5–20 mL over 3–5 min.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store unconstituted dry powder below 25°C. Reconstituted solution in 0.9% NaCl is stable for up to 3 hours at room temperature (25°C) or 24 hours refrigerated (4°C).
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Physically incompatible with and must not be mixed with solutions containing other antibiotics. Severe interaction with valproic acid (causes catastrophic drops in valproate levels).

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for IV Infusion (Imipenem 500 mg + Cilastatin 500 mg Vials) & IM Injection (500/500 mg Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: IV: Reconstitute vial with 10 mL of compatible infusion diluent (0.9% NaCl or D5W); transfer completely to 100 mL infusion bag. IM: Reconstitute with 2 mL 1% Lidocaine HCl.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion: Doses ≤500 mg infuse over 20 to 30 minutes; doses >500 mg infuse over 40 to 60 minutes. Slow infusion if patient develops nausea. IM: Deep intragluteal.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store dry powder below 25°C. Reconstituted IV solution in 0.9% NaCl is stable for 4 hours at room temperature (25°C) and 24 hours under refrigeration (4°C). Do not freeze.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: IM formulation contains lidocaine and MUST NOT be given intravenously. Do not mix with or add to aminoglycoside infusions. Incompatible with sodium bicarbonate.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for Injection (1 g Ertapenem as Sodium per Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: IV: Reconstitute 1 g vial with 10 mL SWFI or 0.9% NaCl; transfer immediately into 50 mL of 0.9% NaCl. IM: Reconstitute 1 g with 3.2 mL of 1% Lidocaine HCl (without epinephrine).
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion: Infuse over 30 minutes once daily. IM Injection: Deep intragluteal injection within 1 hour of preparation. Not for intravenous use if prepared with lidocaine.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store unreconstituted vials below 25°C. Reconstituted infusion solution in 0.9% NaCl must be used within 6 hours at room temperature (25°C) or 24 hours refrigerated (4°C).
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Strictly INCOMPATIBLE with dextrose (D5W) diluents—causes rapid degradation. Do not infuse through the same line as other intravenous drugs.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for IV Infusion (500 mg Doripenem per Single-Use Vial)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute 500 mg vial with 10 mL SWFI or 0.9% NaCl. Transfer entire suspension into 100 mL infusion bag of 0.9% NaCl or D5W.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion: Infuse over 1 hour; for intensive care nosocomial pneumonia or resistant pathogens, administer as an extended infusion over 4 hours.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store unconstituted powder at 25°C. Reconstituted solution in 0.9% NaCl is stable for 4 hours at room temperature and 24 hours refrigerated (4°C). In D5W: stable for 1 hour at room temp.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Incompatible with alkaline solutions and valproic acid. Doripenem powder contains no preservatives; inspect visually for particulate matter prior to administration.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Oral Film-Coated Tablets (150 mg, 200 mg & 300 mg) and Dry Syrup / Oral Suspension (100 mg per 5 mL)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Tablets: Ready-to-use oral solid dosage form. Dry syrup: Reconstitute with specified volume of boiled and cooled purified water; shake vigorously to disperse.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: Oral: Administer with or without food every 8 hours. Swallow tablets whole with water; do not crush or chew. Shake reconstituted pediatric oral suspension well before each dose.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store tablets below 25°C in a dry place protected from light and moisture. Reconstituted oral suspension is stable for 7 days when refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C.
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Antacids containing aluminum and magnesium reduce absorption; administer at least 2 hours apart. Do not co-prescribe with sodium valproate (penems reduce valproate serum levels).

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for IV Infusion (Single-Vial Combination: Meropenem 1 g + Vaborbactam 1 g; 2 vials per standard adult 4 g dose)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute each vial with 20 mL 0.9% NaCl; gently dissolve. Withdraw reconstituted contents of 2 vials (40 mL total) and add to 250 mL 0.9% NaCl infusion bag.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Extended Infusion: Infuse over 3 hours every 8 hours via dedicated infusion line or primary IV line. Do not administer as rapid bolus.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store vials at 20°C to 25°C. The reconstituted and diluted infusion solution in 0.9% NaCl must be completed within 4 hours at room temperature or 22 hours refrigerated (4°C).
formulations_administration.Critical Compatibility Alerts: Compatible ONLY with 0.9% Sodium Chloride. INCOMPATIBLE with Dextrose-containing solutions (causes rapid chemical decomposition). Not compatible with other IV drugs.

formulations_administration.Dosage Form & Strength: Sterile Lyophilized Powder for IV Infusion (Single-Use Vial: Imipenem 500 mg + Cilastatin 500 mg + Relebactam 250 mg)
formulations_administration.Reconstitution Diluent & Volume: Reconstitute vial with 10 mL of 0.9% NaCl (or compatible diluent). Gently swirl to dissolve completely, then transfer entire volume into a 100 mL bag of 0.9% NaCl.
formulations_administration.Administration Route & Infusion Rate: IV Infusion: Infuse over 30 minutes every 6 hours. Administer through dedicated intravenous line; flush line before and after with 0.9% NaCl.
formulations_administration.Storage & Reconstituted Stability: Store lyophilized vials at 20°C to 25°C. Following dilution in 0.9% NaCl, stable for 2 hours at room temperature (25°C) or 24 hours under refrigeration (2°C to 8°C).
